title: FIMBA: Evaluating the Robustness of AI in Genomics via Feature Importance Adversarial Attacks
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of AI model robustness and adversarial attacks in genomics, discussing the potential for harm to patients and the public. It does not, however, contain a component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as a primary research objective.
